censoring_rules.censoring: For patients not known to have died as of data cutoff, censor at last date known to be alive

censoring_rules.event: Objective progression or death due to any cause
censoring_rules.censoring: If responder not known to have died or progressed, censor at date of last evaluable tumor assessment

methods.name: Stratified log-rank test
methods.details: Alpha level of 0.04998 (2-sided), stratified by IWRS stratification values

methods.name: Cox proportional hazards model
methods.details: Stratified identically to the primary log-rank test with assigned treatment as the only covariate

methods.name: Kaplan-Meier method
methods.details: For survival curve estimation, medians, quartiles, and percentages

methods.name: Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel test
methods.details: Adjusting for stratification variables

methods.name: MMRM regression
methods.details: Mixed effect Model Repeat Measurement including treatment, visit, treatment*visit, and baseline

multiplicity.details: OS will be tested only if PFS is significant. Haybittle Peto type spending function for OS interim analysis with p-value bound 0.0001
multiplicity.alpha_allocation: 1-sided type I error rate controlled at 2.5% for OS using spending function

interim_analyses.spending_function: Haybittle Peto type spending function
interim_analyses.details: Safety interim after first 50 patients completed 3 cycles; futility and safety interim after ~107 PFS events with futility boundary p-value >0.39
